market_summary: During the late New York session, broad markets display post-expansion consolidation following earlier aggressive downside runs. BTCUSD remains tightly bound to its session Point of Control (POC) inside its Value Area. Strict discipline dictates HOLD across all assets due to lack of fresh volume confirmation and exhausted session extremes.
